name: redact
description: Redact sensitive data from text, CSV or PDF: emails, phone numbers, CNICs, IBANs, card/account numbers and name-context matches are masked; the redacted copy is written to data/redacted/ and the original is never touched. Fully local.
route: redacting sensitive data from text, CSV or PDF files into a safe copy: names, emails, phone numbers, CNICs, IBANs and account/card numbers are masked, originals never leave this PC
